checks.what: The original gave the Mughals the 26 'Chittagong (Bangladesh)' conflict cells, citing the 1666 annexation of Chatgaon. The packet label is the admin1 Chittagong Division. All 26 cells lie at 90.8-91.4 E, 22.7-23.8 N (Comilla, Noakhali, Feni) and none is in the port of Chittagong (place Chittagong 35 km: 0 of 26). Tripura already lost the port in 1666 (kingdom-of-tripura/ledger/4). The Tripura page dates the plains: Mughal pressure 'culminated in Mughal dominance of the plains of the kingdom in 1733' (kingdom-of-tripura/ledger/5). The History of Chittagong page says nothing about these plains, so the original was unsupported for the land it moved. It also set off a side effect: the 26 taken cells pushed the mughal-empire_1710 snap over tolerance, releasing 9 Sadhaura-Lohgarh cells to the Sikhs at the end of 1710, although sikhs/ledger/3 has the Mughals retaking them in Dec 1710. Trial of the corrected file: the ruling settles 52 cell-years (1710, 1713). The plains stay Tripura's as in the baseline, the Sadhaura side effect is gone, and the Tripura / nawabs-of-bengal conflict of 1717-1718 (52 cell-years) is again won by Tripura under the size rule, which matches the 1733 date.
